title: problem.v1
description: One problem (SUP.9 BP1, BP2, BP4, BP5): a fenced ```yaml problem block in the body of a host issue labelled problem; the issue's number is the problem's ID, named by its tests with @problem[<n>]. The template is required from the start; the analysis — cause, impact, severity — once the status is past open or a test names the problem, and the alert once the severity is high or critical: those are rules of check_problem_record_gate, not of this schema.

where.description: Where it happens: the screen, interface or component as the reporter sees it.

reproduce.description: The steps and input that make it happen.

affected_parties.description: Who else is affected (BP4), e.g. the customer, the teams using a component.

notified.description: The date the affected parties were notified (BP4).

change_request.description: The issue number of the change request that carries the fix, when it needs a change of requirements or design (BP5, SUP.10).
